meta.title: SoundDeck — The ultimate soundboard for Discord
meta.description: Local soundboard for Discord with multi-track audio editor, playlist sequencer, YouTube import, and built-in mic mixer. Free and open source.

hero.subtitle: Multi-track audio editor, playlist sequencer, YouTube import, mic + sounds mixer. Everything you need to spice up your voice sessions.

features.title: Powerful tools, simple interface
features.subtitle: Every feature is built for speed. No hidden menus, no unnecessary setup.

editor.title: Multi-track audio editor
editor.desc: Timeline with clips, fades, markers and audio effects (echo, reverb, speed). Undo/Redo, snap, automatic crossfade.

sequencer.title: Playlist sequencer
sequencer.desc: Chain your sounds with custom delays, loop or shuffle. Perfect for intros and transitions.

import.title: YouTube / MyInstants import
import.desc: Download and import sounds in one click from YouTube, YouTube Music, MyInstants and more.

mixer.title: Mic + sounds mixer
mixer.desc: One virtual cable (VB-Cable), zero complex configuration. No VoiceMeeter needed for most setups.

integrations.title: Works with Discord / OBS / Twitch
integrations.desc: Native integration with OBS WebSocket and Twitch alerts (follows, donations, subs).

i18n.title: Multi-language
i18n.desc: Interface available in French, English and Spanish. Complete translations, no hardcoded strings.

showcase.title: Explore every corner of SoundDeck
showcase.subtitle: 8 pages built for speed. Every screen has a purpose, no feature is hidden.

home.title: My sounds
home.desc: Your personal library, organized by profiles, favorites and tags. Instant search, drag & drop reordering.
bullets: Favorites and tags to find a sound in a second

discover.title: Discover
discover.desc: Thousands of ready-to-use sounds, sorted by category. One-click import, straight into your library.

editor.title: Audio editor
editor.desc: A full multi-track timeline with clips, effects and loops. Build complex mixes without leaving the app.
bullets: Effects: volume, fade, speed, echo, reverb

sequencer.title: Sequencer
sequencer.desc: Chain your sounds with precise delays. Perfect for stream intros, transitions or retros.

trimmer.title: Trimmer
trimmer.desc: Interactive waveform with selection handles. Cut a sound to the second, preview the result before saving.
bullets: Formats: MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, AAC

youtube.title: YouTube import
youtube.desc: Paste a YouTube (or YouTube Music) URL, pick the portion to extract, and it's in your library.
bullets: Auto-selection of the best audio format

stats.title: Statistics
stats.desc: Track your usage: most played sounds, listening time, active profiles. Filter by week, month or all time.
bullets: History by week / month / all time

emoji.title: My emojis
emoji.desc: 212 emojis sorted by category (audio, reactions, animals, games…). Assign one emoji per sound to recognize it at a glance.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: A single virtual cable, zero complex configuration. SoundDeck merges your mic and your sounds into one stream that any app can read.

step1.title: Your inputs
step1.desc: Your microphone and the sounds from your SoundDeck library.

step2.title: SoundDeck mixes
step2.desc: Both streams are merged in real time, with independent volume control.

step3.title: Virtual cable
step3.desc: VB-Cable receives the mix and exposes it as a standard microphone device.

step4.title: Discord & co.
step4.desc: Discord, OBS, Twitch, games… select VB-Cable as their mic. Your friends hear you with the sounds.

how.compatTitle: Works with anything that has voice chat
how.compatDesc: Not just Discord — SoundDeck works with any game or software that accepts an audio input device. You keep your headphones for monitoring, and your friends receive the mix.

pro.title: Unlock all Pro plugins
pro.subtitle: A one-time donation of $5 or more on GitHub Sponsors unlocks lifetime access to all Pro plugins. No subscription, no account, works offline.

free.a: Yes. SoundDeck's core is 100% free and open source under the MIT license. Only some Pro plugins require a license, obtained through a one-time donation.

license.q: How does the Pro license work?
license.a: A one-time donation of $5 or more on GitHub Sponsors unlocks all Pro plugins forever, on an unlimited number of PCs. No subscription, no account to create.

voicemeeter.a: No. SoundDeck includes a built-in mic + sounds mixer. VB-Cable is enough for most setups. VoiceMeeter is still supported for advanced configurations.

os.a: Windows, macOS and Linux. The Windows version is the most tested and most used by the community.

privacy.a: No. All your sounds, profiles and settings are stored locally. Only optional license verification requires an internet connection.

contribute.a: Of course! The project is open source on GitHub. See CONTRIBUTING.md for code conventions, testing rules and the Git workflow.
